user.title: Jandy AquaLink TCX
user.description: Sign in with your iAquaLink / Jandy account. Works on Raspberry Pi and any Home Assistant install — no Supervisor add-on required.

error.invalid_auth: Login rejected by Zodiac/iAquaLink. Use the exact email and password from the iAquaLink app (not your Home Assistant password).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Zodiac / iAquaLink cloud
error.no_devices: Logged in, but no AquaLink TCX controller was found on this account

abort.already_configured: This TCX controller is already configured
